description: Create an API key for a script, the CLI, or an integration. Returns the secret ONCE — it cannot be retrieved again, so hand it to the user immediately and tell them to store it somewhere safe. Maximum 10 active keys. The key can only carry scopes this connection already holds, and payment scopes are never available on an API key.

expiresInDays.description: Optional expiry, 1-3650 days. Omit for a key that does not expire.

name.description: What the key is for, e.g. 'monthly export script'

scopes.description: Permissions for the key. Grant the narrowest set that does the job — it is a long-lived credential.

name: create_api_key
